system.description:
• Effect: Once per day, when reduced below half HP in combat witnessed by at least one ally or enemy, gain temporary HP equal to your Knight level + your Charisma modifier.
  • 24th level: the temporary HP equals twice your Knight level + your Charisma modifier, and you have Advantage on your first attack roll each round until the encounter ends

activities.name: Undying Reputation
activities.text: Once per day, when reduced below half HP in combat witnessed by at least one ally or enemy, gain temporary HP equal to {13:your Knight level, 24:twice your Knight level} + your Charisma modifier. {13:, 24:Until the encounter ends you also have Advantage on your first attack roll each round.}
